actions.name: divine awareness
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows if it hears a lie.

actions.name: exalted restoration
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item Radiant Sword]] attacks or uses [[/item Holy Burst]] twice.

actions.name: holy burst
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=HrgMO1rsQla47fff]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=HrgMO1rsQla47fff]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=HrgMO1rsQla47fff]]-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=HrgMO1rsQla47fff]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectEvil]{Detect Evil and Good} 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCommune000]{Commune}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplControlWea]{Control Weather}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDispelEvil]{Dispel Evil and Good}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRaiseDead0]{Raise Dead}

actions.name: divine aid
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCureWounds]{Cure Wounds}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplInvisibili]{Invisibility}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLesserRest]{Lesser Restoration}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRemoveCurs]{Remove Curse}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
